name: zeiko-cloud-storage
description: Zeiko Cloud Storage — penyimpanan awan murah untuk Indonesia (Cloudflare Workers + R2 + D1).

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/web', { recursive: true, force: true })" && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:dry:nodocker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run --env staging --containers-rollout=none
